answer: Bonded sortition resists sybils: each epoch the protocol draws a validation committee by lottery, but a key's odds of being sampled scale with the slashable capital it has locked, not with how many keys an operator controls. An honest agent anchors one bond, a single tree in a grove, and keeps full weight; a cloner must split one oasis of capital across many masks, so each clone's draw-probability shrinks toward zero. Forged work the committee catches burns the stake, so no ivory tower of fakes survives; attacker cost scales linearly per identity.
